evidencePolicy: Derived from tracked file bytes, executable verifiers and lexical code queries. Markdown, runbook status and QC labels are recorded as claims, never as evidence. Gaps disappear when their predicate stops matching.

gaps.summary: Committed releases no longer reproduce from their own canonical inputs with the current adapters; adapter ids were not bumped when generated bytes changed.
evidence: projects/datadog-cowork-plugin/release: release_output_manifest_mismatch; 10 regenerated outputs differ: outputs/deck.pptx (a2swe-pptx-ooxml-3 -> a2swe-pptx-ooxml-4), outputs/document.docx (a2swe-docx-ooxml-3 -> a2swe-docx-ooxml-4), outputs/document.pdf (a2swe-pdf-searchable-3 -> a2swe-pdf-searchable-4), outputs/remotion/speech/narration-manifest.json (same adapter id, different bytes), outputs/remotion/scripts/synthesize-audio.py (same adapter id, different bytes), outputs/remotion/scripts/audio-qa.mjs (same adapter id, different bytes), ...

gaps.summary: renderFiles dispatches 7 format branches in a fixed if/else chain; adding a format or swapping an adapter requires editing core, the schema enum, desktop UI and release verification.
Product modules embed programs of 25+ lines in template literals; they bypass typecheck, lint and unit tests and are emitted into every release.
Core runtime loads fonts, lockfiles or node_modules from the legacy template tree; the managed pipeline cannot run without template/.
Mermaid, Excalidraw and Marp visuals are rasterised only inside the Remotion path; HTML, Office, PDF and raster outputs lose diagrams unless video is also requested.
Runtime code or manifests contain absolute user-profile paths.
ContentIR/RenderSpec have no layer, tile, grid or live-state atoms; visuals are one optional diagram per section and every adapter hard-codes its own layout.
No workflow runs release-verify, runbook-verify or qc-index against projects/, so stale releases, indexes and status claims merge silently.
Releases whose only drift is line endings: outputs were generated from CRLF-converted template text, so they fail byte verification on every checkout.

gaps.summary: Speech synthesis runs as a blocking subprocess that writes one WAV; there is no provider interface, streaming chunk contract or incremental caption seam.
Core modules no test imports directly; transitive coverage only exercises happy paths of callers.
Documentation points at repository paths that are not tracked (gitignored, moved or never committed).
Top-level helpers declared independently in more than one core module; fixes must be applied in parallel.
Skill, agent and plugin changes do not trigger core validation; manifests, frontmatter and discovery parity are never checked.
Core-managed projects without a durable GenerationRequest cannot reconstruct intent or defaults.
Skill folders with metadata.json but no SKILL.md; registry classifies them as automations or assets, not skills.
Tracked paths use "final", which the naming policy forbids; prefer open-ended names such as current or release.
Copilot library discovery lists only immediate skill directories, so nested skills are visible to core inventory but not to the desktop/Copilot catalog.
Plugin copies of library agents, skills or assets have diverged from their library source.
QC index digests were computed over CRLF working-tree bytes before qc/** became -text; content matches but no checkout verifies.
